name: Enable Gas Transmission / Carthage to Perryville Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: CEGT Perryville Expansion Phase I & 2; Carthage-Perryville Line CP

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. P0161 is the whole Enable network with no endpoints, P0196 Gulf Crossing and P0265 Tiger are different lines, P5968 is a Gulf South expansion. Natural Gas Intelligence reported the FERC certificate in October 2006 for a 172-mile 42-inch line from Carthage, Texas to Perryville, Louisiana, 1.24 Bcf/d, docket CP06-85, then owned by CenterPoint Energy Gas Transmission. The EIA August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 484, lists CEGT Perryville Expansion Phase I & 2: completed, in service 2008-02-05, 172 mi, 42 in, 1237 MMcf/d, cost 425 (millions) so staged as 425000000 USD. Length is 172 mi, well over the 15.5 mi threshold. Enable acquired the line from CenterPoint and Energy Transfer later bought Enable, so confirm the current owner name and parent with the ownership team. Later phases on the same line (EIA rows 508 Phase 3 and 638 Phase IV) are compression or loop work and were not checked here. Route not researched; EIA and NGI give endpoints only, so route type is unavailable until a route is found. Single FERC docket number is from the consolidator note and the NGI headline, not independently opened.
